ownerStatement: Release Kits 0.1.0-experimental. I waive the static cycle bound and the hardware qualification of this exact build for this version.
reason: A port of Sam Banks' octabam KITS (MIT, his OK on 13 November 2026) onto base 0.7.4's hooks and ot_sample_memory. On the owner's MKII (a development twin of 0.7.4 with ot_sample_memory, 16 November 2026) it ran as trials: it took its 331 pages of sample memory at install, kept them through a project load, gave them back at removal, loaded Kits while playing beside 14 kept modules, and cost +0.1 points of CPU at rest, with no skipped render, crash or stall (TESTING.md). No static cycle count was made, and device:qualify did not run on the exact release package and base.
